environment.guest_settings: scrub inherited PS2_/GT4_PERF_ options; set GT4_PERF=1 PS2_SCALE=1 PS2_GS=gpu
environment.vulkan: preserve and record VK_ overrides in session result; other driver/overlay state not controlled
environment.gs_submission: GT4_GS_SYNC=0 default (asynchronous); GT4_GS_SYNC=1 restores the fully synchronous path (launcher records the value in the session result)

toolchain.build: CMake/Ninja VS2022 x64 ABI Windows SDK10.0.26100.0

classification: O2 candidate: VU1 AOT (slice151 table) plus asynchronous GS submission. Ring of 3 slots on one timeline semaphore; presents limited to 2 in flight; VRAM equal to the synchronous path in the stress comparison and headless smoke (see controls). Owner play pending.
preserved_inputs: Production EE,143port/9shaders/donor input pins; all143/145 build/capsules untouched

controls.ctest: CTest 17/17 on this build: vulkan_fixture (async and GT4_GS_SYNC=1), gs_submit_ring_fixture, async stress (async VRAM byte-identical to GT4_GS_SYNC=1), vu_recomp suites, vu1_aot_registry, python_native_contracts (Python 203 tests OK, one pre-existing skip)
controls.headless_smoke: 4200 frames, fixed 12-press schedule, no window: 42 frame dumps (every 100) identical across two synchronous runs and one asynchronous run; every 700th frame identical in all runs. Wall time 30-35 s per run including boot (not a frame-time result)
controls.validation: VK_LAYER_KHRONOS_validation with VK_LAYER_VALIDATE_SYNC=1: zero errors with implicit overlay layers disabled (fixture both modes, stress, 1200-frame boot). With implicit layers on, fixture presentation reports SYNC-HAZARD-PRESENT-AFTER-WRITE once per presentation; the old slice 151 adapter reports the same class
controls.frame_sha256_every_700: sync and async identical; see private/slice152-smoke/*/smoke-summary.json (private, not committed)
controls.headless_command: run_probe(frames=4200, timeout=1500 s, window=False, card=private/slice113-video/widescreen-seed/card.ps2, GT4_GS_SYNC=0|1); the O1c press schedule was not recorded, so this schedule is new

limits: Only the programs in the generated table run as AOT; other VU1 programs stay interpreted (interpreted_calls counts them).
Verification compares registers, VU1 memory and XGKICK bytes for top-level calls only; nested dispatch calls run unverified.
The interpreter fallback after a budget exhaustion restarts its own 1,000,000-instruction cap; flag history is not carried across resume.
No owner per-unit measurement exists yet for this binary; the headless smoke is a frame-hash control, not a speed result.

review.note: Owner gameplay and overlay check not run; headless and CTest evidence only.

owner_launch.ab_synchronous_gs: set GT4_GS_SYNC=1 (PowerShell: $env:GT4_GS_SYNC=1) then python scripts/play_performance.py --assets-root . --mode gs-async

vu1_aot.report: F8 perf report and every GT4_VU1_REPORT_EVERY calls: vu1_aot compiled/interpreted/budget/identity/verify counters; vu1_aot timing category
